intro.text: A lion spends most of its life doing absolutely nothing.

hours.text: Between sixteen and twenty hours a day, it lies in the shade and rests.

compare.text: A person sleeps about eight hours. A giraffe, about five. The lion is in a league of its own.

lazy.text: So is the lion just lazy? Not quite. Hunting is brutal.

hunt.text: A few seconds of sprinting burns a huge amount of energy, and only about one hunt in four ends in a meal.

save.text: So the lion saves its strength, and spends the hottest hours doing as little as possible.

close.text: Rest isn't laziness. For a lion, it's a strategy.
